01b71f93 ascii         const originalBytes = bytes;
01b71fbb ascii         if (Math.abs(bytes) < step) {
01b71fe2 ascii           return bytes + " B";
01b72002 ascii         }
01b7200f ascii         const units = [" KB", " MB", " GB"];
01b7203d ascii         let u = -1;

01b7206c ascii         do {
01b7207a ascii           bytes /= step;
01b72094 ascii           u += 1;

01b720be ascii         } while (Math.abs(bytes) >= step && u < units.length - 1);

01b7ba71 ascii     <span class="title">Media Router Example</span>
01b7baa6 ascii     <p>
01b7baaf ascii       <b>Overview:</b>
01b7bac7 ascii       Chromium supports communication with devices on the local network via the
01b7bb18 ascii       <a href="https://blog.oakbits.com/google-cast-protocol-overview.html" target="_blank">Cast</a> and
01b7bb82 ascii       <a href="http://www.dial-multiscreen.org/" target="_blank">DIAL</a> protocols.
01b7bbd8 ascii       CEF exposes this functionality via the CefMediaRouter interface which is demonstrated by this test.
01b7bc43 ascii       Test code is implemented in resources/media_router.html and browser/media_router_test.cc.
01b7bca4 ascii     </p>
01b7bcae ascii     <p>
01b7bcb7 ascii       <b>Usage:</b>
01b7bccc ascii       Devices available on your local network will be discovered automatically and populated in the "Sink" list.
01b7bd3e ascii       Enter a URN for "Source", select an available device from the "Sink" list, and click the "Create Route" button.
01b7bdb5 ascii       Cast URNs take the form "cast:<i>&lt;appId&gt;</i>?clientId=<i>&lt;clientId&gt;</i>" and DIAL URNs take the form "dial:<i>&lt;appId&gt;</i>",
01b7be4a ascii       where <i>&lt;appId&gt;</i> is the <a href="https://developers.google.com/cast/docs/registration" target="_blank">registered application ID</a>
01b7bee0 ascii       and <i>&lt;clientId&gt;</i> is an arbitrary numeric identifier.
01b7bf27 ascii       Status information and messages will be displayed in the center of the screen.
01b7bf7d ascii       After creating a route you can send messages to the receiver app using the textarea at the bottom of the screen.
01b7bff5 ascii       Messages are usually in JSON format with a example of Cast communication to be found
01b7c051 ascii       <a href="https://bitbucket.org/chromiumembedded/cef/issues/2900/add-mediarouter-support-for-cast-receiver#comment-56680326" target="_blank">here</a>.
01b7c0ee ascii     </p>
